english.note: Use 送 as the all-purpose choice for taking or delivering a person or physical thing somewhere.

examples.english: I’ll send the document to you.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sung3 fan6 man4 gin6 bei2 nei5

english.note: Use this when the thing is being given specifically as a present or gift, rather than simply transferred.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 sung3 nei5 ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6
